llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required credential (APICLAW_API_KEY) are consistent with an Amazon product-research integration; no obvious mismatches or hidden endpoints were found — but note it persists API keys to a local config file by design.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Amazon product research) match the advertised files, endpoints, and required APICLAW_API_KEY. The included CLI script implements the documented endpoints and the reference materials align with the declared purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions limit network activity to api.apiclaw.io and instruct the agent to execute scripts/apiclaw.py for API calls. The SKILL.md explicitly instructs writing a user-provided API key to config.json (persistence) and to automatically call realtime/product for top ASINs in Full mode — these behaviors are within the skill's purpose but grant the skill discretion to perform multiple live API calls and to persist credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only skill). The one supplied script is plain Python (no obfuscated downloads); there is no external installer or third-party package retrieval. Risk from install actions is low.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (APICLAW_API_KEY) is required, which is proportional to the service. However, the skill instructs storing the key into a local config.json fallback, which persists a secret to disk (the repo claims config.json is gitignored). Consider whether you want keys persisted versus provided via environment variables.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not modify other skills or system settings. It does, by design/instruction, persist API keys to config.json in the skill directory which gives it lasting access to the API if the agent later runs autonomously — this is convenient but elevates persistence of the credential.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for Amazon research and only needs the APICLAW_API_KEY. Before installing: (1) Prefer supplying the API key via an environment variable rather than letting the agent write it into config.json (to avoid accidental persistence or git leaks). (2) Review scripts/apiclaw.py (already included) and verify the base URL (https://api.apiclaw.io) is the expected vendor. (3) Be aware Full-mode automatically issues extra realtime/product calls for top ASINs — that may increase API usage/quotas and expose more queries to the API. (4) If you must provide a key for a single session, clear or remove config.json afterwards. If you want higher assurance, run the script yourself locally to confirm behavior before granting the key to an autonomous agent.
